value.rationale: The first nontrivial mixed-request optimum at six requests in dimension three matches the sharp known functional-PIR lower bound, strengthening the 2019 repeated-target theorem. An eleven-server design is shorter than elementary concatenation of the known seven-server four-functional-batch code with two extra arbitrary-request basis blocks (thirteen servers), while every request uses at most three servers. This is a natural exact capacity benchmark rather than an arbitrary computed slice.
